title: Longitudinal vibration modes of a laterally constrained clamped-free layer (analytic, eigenfrequency)
description:
A 10 x 1 mm strip (40 x 4 cells of 0.25 mm; E = 70 GPa, rho = 2200 kg/m^3), plane strain, clamped at x_lo (fixed), free at x_hi, on rollers at y_lo and y_hi (u_y = 0, u_x free): eigenfrequency study (solid_mechanics, target_frequency 0, 4 modes), sweep of the Poisson ratio over 0-0.4.
Analytic: the rollers forbid lateral motion, so the lowest modes are u_x = sin(k_n x), u_y = 0 with the constrained (P-wave) modulus M = E (1 - nu) / ((1 + nu)(1 - 2 nu)): f_n = (2n - 1) c_L / (4 L), c_L = sqrt(M / rho) (154.5 kHz for nu = 0.25). In the bilinear elements with the consistent mass these modes are exact discrete modes of the 1D linear-element bar: f_n = sqrt(6 M / (rho h^2) (1 - cos t_n) / (2 + cos t_n)) / (2 pi), t_n = (2n - 1) pi / (2 N), N = L / h (the continuum f_n differs by ~t_n^2 / 24: 6e-5 for mode 1, 3e-3 for mode 4). Shear-type modes start near c_S / (2 H) = 1.7-1.8 MHz, above the four requested.
Derived values tab: f_1..f_4 (picked from the resonance table by a 1 % window) against the discrete references, exact to ~1e-8 (float64 K and M, eigsh); f_1_bar and f_4_bar against the continuum bar formula (~6e-5 and ~3e-3 high: consistent mass).
Sweep tab: f_1 vs nu_bar with the dashed discrete curve (M grows from E to 2.14 E).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, nu = 0.4): u_x along the strip of snapshot 'resonance 1' = sin(pi x / (2 L)) cos(pi / (4 N)) (cell centre = mean of the corner values, peak node |u| = 1 m at the free end), of 'resonance 2' = -sin(3 pi x / (2 L)) cos(3 pi / (4 N)) (sign: the peak component is made positive), and stress_xx of resonance 1 = M (2 / h) sin(pi / (4 N)) cos(pi x / (2 L)); float32 outputs, ~1e-6.
